type: Governance Framework — Operational Monitoring for Dormant Lane
purpose: Define the review criteria and monitoring triggers for future 600-series reassessment. This framework governs how the dormant lane is monitored over time without accidental activation or governance drift.
authority: S600 Charter §9 (Charter Governance), S725 Row 16 (annual reactivation criteria review), S724 Agent V Governance Preservation
monitoring_philosophy: A dormant lane is not monitored for activity (there is none). It is monitored for RELEVANCE — whether the conditions that justified the deferral have changed. Monitoring is a governance function, not a 600-series function. It is performed by the Governance Auditor (700-series maintenance mode) at standard cadences.

t0_per_session.label: T0 Session Startup Check
t0_per_session.frequency: Every session (per AGENTS.md §9 — Session Startup Protocol)
t0_per_session.scope: Passive — confirm 600-series artifacts unchanged since last session
checks: Confirm S600 Charter hash unchanged (SESSION600_CONTENT_OPERATIONS_RESERVE_CHARTER.md)
Confirm S601 activation board decision has not been modified
Confirm S725 Lane 600 definition has not been altered
Confirm zero new 600-attributed artifacts in reports/ directory
Confirm Certified count has not been modified by 600-authority (800-series changes only)
t0_per_session.action_on_violation: ESCALATE to Governance Auditor. If charter has been modified without authorization, trigger G1-G5 reconciliation per AGENTS.md §13.4.

rapid_pulse_5_sessions.label: Rapid Pulse Audit
rapid_pulse_5_sessions.frequency: Every 5 sessions (per S725 Lane 700 maintenance mode cadence)
rapid_pulse_5_sessions.scope: Active — cross-reference 600-state against activation trigger registry
checks: Re-run Activation Trigger Registry (SESSION602_ACTIVATION_TRIGGER_REGISTRY.json) against current portfolio state
Verify all 4 mandatory gates remain FAIL (any PASS triggers an alert to Governance Board)
Verify zero drift in S600 Charter or S725 Lane 600 definition
Verify economic gate: recalculate startup cost vs. savings with current portfolio data
Verify no cross-lane boundary violations (600 artifacts in 300/700/800 spaces)
rapid_pulse_5_sessions.action_on_violation: If any mandatory gate flips to PASS, ESCALATE to Governance Board for activation re-evaluation. If boundary violation detected (e.g., unauthorized 600 artifacts), HALT and spawn ownership-reconciliation agent.

deep_audit_20_sessions.label: Deep Audit — 600-Series Relevance Assessment
deep_audit_20_sessions.frequency: Every 20 sessions (per S723 Maintenance Framework cadence for deferred lanes)
deep_audit_20_sessions.scope: Comprehensive — full re-evaluation of deferral justification
checks: Full economic gate re-evaluation with current empirical data (800-series throughput, EW authoring velocity, acceptance rates)
Binding constraint analysis: has author capacity vs. tooling shifted?
S724 Agent V 5 criteria re-evaluation (AV_1 through AV_5)
Portfolio growth assessment: has item count justified dedicated infrastructure?
S725 Ownership Matrix gaps assessment: has GAP-3 been resolved? Have new gaps emerged?
Cross-series dependency impact: have 300/700/800 series changes affected 600 relevance?
Governance guard integrity: has Rule 2 (DL-008) been upgraded to AM-1 per S725 standards?
Stewardship acceptance status: has Governance Board accepted S725 Row 16?
deep_audit_20_sessions.output: SESSION6XX_DEEP_AUDIT_600_RELEVANCE.md — comprehensive report with: (a) current state assessment, (b) gate-by-gate status, (c) recommendation (CONTINUE DORMANCY / FLAG FOR BOARD REVIEW / RECOMMEND ACTIVATION REVIEW)
deep_audit_20_sessions.action_on_violation: If recommendation is 'RECOMMEND ACTIVATION REVIEW,' the Governance Board must schedule a formal activation review session (not S601/S602 — a new session with full A-Z agent deployment per S724 model).

annual_stewardship_review.label: Annual Stewardship Review — Lane 600
annual_stewardship_review.scope: Governance — charter relevance and governance debt assessment
checks: Is the S600 Charter still the correct operating model for a future 600 activation? (or has the portfolio evolved beyond the charter's assumptions?)
Are the activation conditions still appropriate? (or have new governance standards changed what 'ready' means?)
Is GAP-3 still PENDING? (if yes, escalate to Governance Board for resolution)
Does the S725 Ownership Matrix need amendment for Lane 600?
Are all 5 stewardship principles satisfied for the deferred lane?
Should the charter be version-bumped? (reflect any governance lessons from 800-series operations)
annual_stewardship_review.output: SESSION6XX_ANNUAL_LANE600_STEWARDSHIP_REVIEW.md — recommendation: (a) CONTINUE DORMANCY — no changes, (b) CHARTER AMENDMENT RECOMMENDED, (c) CLOSE LANE — portfolio has evolved beyond need for 600-series
annual_stewardship_review.action_on_violation: Charter amendment requires Executive Board vote per S600 Charter §9.1. Lane closure requires Governance Board authorization per S726 Closure Gate.

drift_detection_signals.description: The following signals indicate potential governance drift in the 600-series dormant lane. Any of these triggers at any cadence automatically escalates to the Governance Auditor.

signals.signal: New artifact in reports/ or knowledge/ with '600-series' or 'SESSION6**' attribution
signals.interpretation: Possible stealth activation — a session produced 600-series work without authorization.
signals.action: HALT all active agents. Spawn governance audit agent. Trace artifact to producing session. If unauthorized, quarantine artifact and escalate to Executive Board.

signals.signal: Any mandatory gate transitions from FAIL to PASS
signals.interpretation: Activation conditions are improving — the dormant lane may be approaching relevance.
signals.action: Governance Auditor triggers Deep Audit (not Rapid Pulse) at next session boundary. Do not automatically activate — a gate transition is a review trigger, not an activation trigger.

signals.signal: S600 Charter file modified without REVISION_HISTORY.md entry
signals.interpretation: Charter tampering — the governing document for 600 activation has been changed outside governance process.
signals.action: HALT. Revert from backup. Trace modification. Escalate to Governance Board.

signals.signal: New REVISION_HISTORY.md entry attributing work to 600-series
signals.interpretation: A session has claimed 600-series authority. This is either authorized (activation) or unauthorized (governance violation).
signals.action: Cross-reference against Executive Board vote records. If no vote exists, the entry is unauthorized — revert and escalate.

signals.signal: GAP-3 resolution: Governance Board accepts S725 Row 16 ownership
signals.interpretation: The ownership gap is closing — governance hygiene is improving. Does not affect activation status.
signals.action: Update S602 Ownership Conflict Review (C-005 → RESOLVED). Update S725 Ownership Acceptance Registry.

signals.signal: 800-series certification completes (100% Certified across all packs)
signals.interpretation: The 800-series pipeline reaches its endpoint. The 'post-certification modernization phase' (S724 Agent V criterion AV_4) begins.
signals.action: Re-evaluate AV_4: is batch DL-013/DL-031 ops becoming the bottleneck? If yes, flag for Governance Board discussion. Does not automatically trigger activation.

review_ownership.primary_reviewer: Governance Auditor (700-series Maintenance Mode) — responsible for executing all cadenced checks on schedule
review_ownership.secondary_reviewer: Baseline Maintainer — responsible for hash verification of S600 Charter at T0
review_ownership.escalation_recipient: Governance Board (collective) — receives all ESCALATE signals
review_ownership.decision_authority: Executive Board (300 + 700 + 800 leads) — only entity authorized to vote on 600-series activation

next_scheduled_check: T0 at start of S603 (next session boundary)
